goals.detail: All active systems running cleanly. Trades firing and managing properly, data collecting and syncing without silent failures, bugs resolved.
Every strategy in the fleet is regime-aware. All trades are tagged with the full regime state vector, and the intelligence layer is accumulating data toward its first tuning cycle.

Confluence zones generating on NQ, historically validated against five years of data. Paper trading live with regime filtering. The team can see the zones before each session and watch price respect them.

The paper trading engine, its data pipelines, metrics, and promotion gates are all verified and reliable. When the system says a strategy is ready for live capital, the team believes it without caveats.

goals.text: At least one new strategy promoted or live
goals.detail: One additional strategy has passed all validation gates and is either deployed on a prop account or ready for deployment.

goals.text: Bob and Adam can run the full pipeline end-to-end
goals.detail: Either researcher can take a strategy from idea to deployed ATS independently. Vash focuses on architecture, R&D, and expanding the platform.

goals.text: Centurion defined with a clear roadmap
goals.detail: The adaptive trader vision has a complete design document, phased timeline, dependency map, and team alignment. Ready to begin building in Q2.
Clear objectives for June 30 defined, including expansion targets, project milestones, and priorities for the next quarter.
